issues.description: EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED reference may not exist in upstream enum, breaking import/runtime
issues.detail: The diff adds `EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED` to the `_enable_vad` check (line ~337) without showing where this enum value is defined. If the speechmatics-python SDK 0.0.99 does not expose a `FIXED` member on `EndOfUtteranceMode`, this will raise AttributeError at construction time. Needs verification that the SDK actually exposes this value.

issues.description: Breaking default change from EXTERNAL to FIXED not flagged as a breaking change
issues.detail: The default `turn_detection_mode` changes from `EXTERNAL` to `FIXED`, and `_enable_vad` semantics now differ. Existing users relying on the prior default behavior (VAD enabled, listening to `UserStoppedSpeakingFrame`) will see different endpointing behavior silently. This belongs in a `.breaking.md` changelog, not just `.fixed.md`.

issues.description: Switch from UserStoppedSpeakingFrame to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame silently drops non-VAD finalization triggers
issues.detail: `process_frame` now only finalizes on `VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame` instead of `UserStoppedSpeakingFrame`. Pipelines that emit `UserStoppedSpeakingFrame` from non-VAD sources (turn analyzers, manual triggers, smart-turn endpointers upstream) will no longer trigger `self._client.finalize()`. Confirm this is intentional and document the contract.

issues.description: speech_segment_config unconditionally overwritten, ignoring user-supplied extra_config
issues.detail: Line ~517 unconditionally assigns `config.speech_segment_config = SpeechSegmentConfig(emit_sentences=...)`. If a user supplies a more complete `speech_segment_config` via the existing extra_config/passthrough mechanism, it is clobbered. Should merge or only set the `emit_sentences` field on an existing config object.

issues.description: Docstring lists TurnDetectionMode options but omits the new FIXED in one place
issues.detail: The class-level docstring at line ~67 now says default is `FIXED` but the body still says "use `TurnDetectionMode.ADAPTIVE` for simple voice activity detection or `TurnDetectionMode.SMART_TURN`" without explaining what FIXED actually does versus EXTERNAL. Add a one-line description distinguishing FIXED from EXTERNAL so users can pick correctly.

issues.description: Commented-out start_processing_metrics call moved but not removed
issues.detail: In `_handle_start_of_turn`, the `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` line was relocated above the broadcast rather than deleted or implemented. Dead commented code should either be wired up (so processing metrics work) or removed, not shuffled within the function.

review.summary: The PR updates SpeechmaticsSTTService for SDK 0.0.99 with reasonable intent, but introduces a silent breaking default change (EXTERNAL -> FIXED) without a breaking changelog entry, and depends on an `EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED` enum value whose existence in the SDK isn't shown in the diff. The switch from `UserStoppedSpeakingFrame` to `VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame` narrows the finalization trigger and could regress non-VAD pipelines. Minor concerns: `speech_segment_config` is unconditionally overwritten, dead commented metrics call was moved instead of removed, and the docstring doesn't explain FIXED vs EXTERNAL semantics for users picking a mode.
